typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	ErrorEmailMessage as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	File_IID as integer (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	NonMatchingProviders as integer (),
	QuarantineFile as string (),
	QuarantinePath as string (),
	SuccessEmailMessage as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Facets Provider ID #} as string,
		Providers as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> TXMHDCSV
TXMHDCSV sink(input(
		PRPR_ID as string,
		PROVIDER_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PRPR_ID = {Facets Provider ID #},
		PROVIDER_NAME = Providers)) ~> TMPMHDPROVIDERS
